rules.title: An Act prohibiting algorithmic rent setting (S.2983)
rules.requirement: A pending Massachusetts Senate bill would prohibit algorithmic rent setting in the rental housing market. The page does not include the bill's substantive terms.
rules.coverage_conditions: Statewide residential rental housing (proposed). Specific coverage terms are not stated on the bill history page.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Bill text not shown; coverage and exemptions unknown
